decisions.decision: Require bounded paired case-level net-utility differences, deterministic contract/guardrail predicates, one-sided/two-sided Hoeffding inference, and Holm family correction. Aggregate scores and single runs abstain.
decisions.remaining_work: Define and freeze task-specific score, cost, contract, and guardrail adapters before any empirical certificate run.

decisions.decision: Order candidates by retained SCC count ascending, discovery margin descending, normalized cost ascending, then atom IDs lexicographically.
A direct-baseline output that cannot be mapped to the common atom schema is an abstention retained in the denominator.

Held-out pairs must use new papers, public source material, executable assets, locked objective scorers, complete skills/source maps, and no development overlap. Current eight tasks are development-only.
decisions.remaining_work: Create and approve the candidate registry before selecting at least four held-out pairs.
